biggest_catch: Your friend must earn at least $75 in study incentives before you see a dollar of referral bonus — and there is no stated friend-side bonus; the official policy only pays the referrer.
catches: Signup referral ('Share Respondent'): your friend signs up via your link; once they have earned $75+ in total incentive payments (across studies) with payment status PAID, your $20 bonus processes.

Project referral: your friend signs up via your project referral link, is selected, completes that specific study, and their payment status shows PAID — then your $50 bonus processes (the study must be a $100+ incentive project).
All referral bonuses are paid via a Tremendous virtual gift card to your primary email address within 7–10 business days.
No official friend-side bonus is stated in the policy — the friend earns their normal study incentives; disclose honestly.
The friend must be brand-new: existing or previously deleted accounts do not qualify, and each signup bonus is earned once per user.
There is no time limit on the signup bonus — it is awarded whenever the friend reaches $75 in incentives.

c2.evidence: Official Respondent help center article states the $20 and $50 bonuses, the $75 incentive threshold, Tremendous payout, and 7–10 business day timing.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate in the referral program.

c4.evidence: Official policy: 'Once they've earned $75+ in total incentive payments ... your $20 bonus processes' and 'Once their payment status shows as PAID, your $50 bonus processes.' Friend-side: no bonus stated in official policy — disclosed as such.

eligibility: Referrer: a Respondent participant (Settings → Referrals). Friend: a brand-new user who signs up via the referral link and participates in studies; existing or deleted accounts do not qualify.

steps: Go to Settings → Referrals on Respondent to get your 'Share Respondent' link or a project referral link.
Share the link with someone who's never used Respondent.
They sign up using your link and start participating in studies.
Signup referral: once they earn $75+ in total incentive payments with status PAID, your $20 bonus processes.
Project referral: once they complete the specific study and their status shows PAID, your $50 bonus processes.
You receive a Tremendous virtual gift card within 7–10 business days.
